searchText: Am I right in thinking that there's no way to get slashed when performing sync committee duties? ie I could produce two `SyncCommitteeSignature` for the same slot but different block roots and not get slashed. And is there a particular reason we don't need to slash misbehaving validators in sync committees? Have anyone decided on how much ETH that will be minted per block? do you mean the staking rewards? Yeah it is in the spec 64 ETH? Or the values are in gwei?
